scenes.title: Lost in the Future
scenes.narration_text: The man from Vizag struggled to comprehend the futuristic surroundings. A figure approached him, dressed in attire that shimmered like the city lights. The figure spoke to him in Telugu, asking what was going on, why he was dressed in his clothes, and why he was speaking Telugu. The protagonist explained his situation, and the guide's expression changed from amusement to curiosity.

dialogue.text: Elaa bro, ikkada emi jarugutundhi? Nee dress emanna, ippudu ippatiki Telugu matladtunnav?

scenes.visual_prompt: A futuristic cityscape with a mix of neon lights and sleek architecture. The protagonist, dressed in casual clothes, looks disoriented and out of place. The guide, dressed in shimmering attire, approaches him with a mixture of amusement and curiosity on their face. The scene is lit with a warm glow, with shadows accentuating the futuristic elements.
scenes.negative_prompt: avoid over-the-top sci-fi elements, focus on the protagonist's disorientation
scenes.music_mood: mellow electronic with a hint of Indian classical music

scenes.title: Lost in a New World

characters.name: Ravi
characters.action: explaining the city's layout and customs

scenes.narration_text: The guide introduced himself as Ravi and began to explain the city's layout and its customs, but the protagonist's mind was elsewhere, trying to grasp how he ended up in this strange new world. Ravi, noticing his confusion, suggested they visit a local information hub where they could find more about the portal the protagonist came through and possibly a way back home.
scenes.visual_prompt: A futuristic cityscape with a mix of Eastern and Western architectural styles, vibrant colors, and a sense of disorientation. The protagonist, a young adult with a confused expression, stands next to Ravi, a guide with a concerned look on his face. The background should include a large information hub with a glowing portal in the distance. Art style: a blend of realistic and stylized elements. Lighting: soft and diffused, with a hint of mystery. Composition: the protagonist and Ravi should be centered, with the information hub and portal in the background. Colors: a palette of blues and purples to convey a sense of uncertainty. Mood: mysterious and slightly ominous.
scenes.negative_prompt: no fantasy creatures, no sci-fi elements beyond the portal
scenes.music_mood: contemplative ambient electronic with a hint of mystery

scenes.title: The Information Hub

characters.name: Ravi
characters.action: leading the protagonist to a central console

characters.name: Protagonist
characters.location_in_scene: behind Ravi, near the central console

scenes.narration_text: As they entered the information hub, a vast, spherical room filled with holographic displays and strange, glowing orbs, Ravi led the protagonist to a central console. The console, responding to Ravi's commands in Telugu, 'Samacharam pampu' (Display information), flashed a hologram of the city's history and the portal system.
scenes.visual_prompt: A futuristic, spherical room with holographic displays and glowing orbs. The central console is a sleek, high-tech device with a holographic display. The atmosphere is bright and futuristic. The art style is a blend of sci-fi and Indian culture. The colors are a mix of blues and whites, with accents of bright, neon colors. The mood is curious and inquiring. The scene elements include holographic displays, glowing orbs, and a central console.
scenes.music_mood: upbeat, futuristic electronic with a hint of Indian classical

scenes.title: The Prophecy Unfolds

setting.location: A futuristic console or control room

characters.name: Ravi
characters.action: reading the message on the console

characters.name: The Protagonist
characters.action: watching the images on the console

scenes.narration_text: The protagonist's eyes widened as he saw images of his hometown, Vizag, and the manhole he had jumped into, labeled as a 'temporary rift' in the fabric of space-time. Suddenly, the console beeped, and a message in Telugu appeared, 'Aadavitii vijayam, andariki telusu' (The prophecy is known to all). Ravi's expression turned grave, 'Bro, nee raa, ikkada vijayam lo bhagam untadhu' (You, my friend, have a role in the prophecy).

dialogue.text: Bro, nee raa, ikkada vijayam lo bhagam untadhu (You, my friend, have a role in the prophecy)

scenes.visual_prompt: A futuristic console room with a large screen displaying images of Vizag and the manhole. Ravi and the protagonist are standing in front of the console, with Ravi looking grave and the protagonist looking surprised. The lighting is dimly lit with console lights, and the atmosphere is serious and ominous. Art style: dark sci-fi, colors: muted blues and greys, mood: suspenseful.
scenes.music_mood: dark ambient electronic with distant strings

scenes.title: The Prophecy's Dark Omen

setting.lighting: flickering holographic lights, dimmed fluorescent panels

scenes.narration_text: As Ravi delved deeper into the prophecy, the air in the information hub grew thick with an eerie silence. The protagonist's eyes scanned the room, noticing the flickering holographic lights and dimmed fluorescent panels, which seemed to heighten the sense of foreboding. Ravi's voice, now laced with a sense of urgency, explained that a powerful faction, known as the 'Andhras', sought to exploit the prophecy for their own gain.

dialogue.text: Ravi's voice, now laced with a sense of urgency, explained that a powerful faction, known as the 'Andhras', sought to exploit the prophecy for their own gain.

scenes.visual_prompt: Dark, gritty sci-fi art style with flickering holographic lights, dim fluorescent panels, and a sense of foreboding. Composition: protagonist in the center, Ravi in the background. Colors: muted blues and greys with flashes of red. Mood: ominous and urgent.

scenes.music_mood: dark ambient electronic with ominous strings

scenes.title: Escape from the Hub

characters.name: Ravi
characters.action: grabbing the protagonist's arm and rushing out

scenes.narration_text: Ravi grabbed the protagonist's arm, 'Raa, ikkada nee, vellu, Bhairava vachadu' (Come, we must leave, Bhairava is coming). As Ravi and the protagonist rushed out of the information hub, the city's streets transformed into a maze of danger. The neon lights that once seemed so welcoming now cast long, ominous shadows.
scenes.visual_prompt: a dark and ominous cityscape with neon lights casting long shadows, a maze of danger in the streets, a sense of urgency and fear, art style: gritty and realistic, lighting: low-key with deep shadows, composition: dynamic and chaotic, colors: dark blues and purples, mood: foreboding and intense, scene elements: Ravi and the protagonist rushing out of the information hub, Bhairava looming in the background
scenes.negative_prompt: bright and welcoming cityscape, calm and peaceful atmosphere
scenes.music_mood: dark and ominous electronic with pulsing synths

scenes.title: Suspicious Encounter
scenes.narration_text: The protagonist's eyes met Leela's, and for a fleeting moment, he thought he saw a glimmer of deceit. He asked her if everything was okay, trying to sound casual. Leela's response was hesitant, and the protagonist's mind was racing with questions.

dialogue.text: Emanna, bro, nee raa, vellu, Bhairava vachadu
